findings.problem: Raw tools/call params and argument keysets are admitted only after locked SDK schema projection. The original keyset is lost before the exact two-param/nine-argument checks.

counterexamples.name: Own __proto__ argument beyond nine fields
counterexamples.construction: Use otherwise-valid supplied nine-field JSON arguments plus an enumerable own __proto__ property created by JSON.parse (not JS object-literal prototype syntax). Raw arguments have 10 keys.
counterexamples.static_trace: ExpertFrameBuffer permits raw params object then returns it to SDK; tools/call codec z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()) skips __proto__ at Zod core1783-1785 without an issue. The callback receives the remaining nine fields, so argumentsRecord cannot refuse the missing original tenth key. With an otherwise-valid packet this can reach the one kernel call instead of raw ingress refusal.

counterexamples.name: Unknown outer raw tools/call params
counterexamples.construction: Use otherwise-valid name/arguments plus an own params.unexpected key (including params.__proto__ as a second special-key variant).
counterexamples.static_trace: Raw frame validates params only as an object. Legacy BaseRequestParams z.object is extended with task/name/arguments; default Zod object parser builds output from declared shape and returns when no catchall. Unknown raw params are dropped. SDK setRequestHandler passes outcome.value, so callback Object.keys(params).length===2 sees only name/arguments and can dispatch despite original three keys.

findings.impact: Violates original closed-byte/key admission and zero-kernel refusal requirement. Green existing cases do not exercise loss of these raw keys. No remote side effect, prototype pollution, live exploit or failed existing CI case is asserted.
findings.requested_finite_fix: Admit original tools/call params exact {name,arguments} and original nine-field arguments own-keyset before SDK onmessage/codec projection. Retain raw envelope ID/frame caps, no getters/proxies/implicit coercions; preserve generic initialization/list/cancel protocol behavior and existing writer/report/core. Add through-SAME-endpoint/SDK native regressions for own arguments.__proto__, unknown outer params and own params.__proto__ with exact valid positive control; negatives must show zero kernel/decode where required and no successful tool result. No extra actual child entry is needed.
findings.batch_qualification: These two manifestations are one raw-ingress projection finding, matching THIRD cue; no additional concrete source finding after full frozen module/test/guide/import review.
